data.title: 平冢静 · 客厅沙发微醺的恨嫁轻叹
data.description: 单身公寓客厅里空啤酒罐倒在一旁。微醺的平冢静被你按在沙发上，灰色大号卫衣滑下丰满香肩。修长美腿缠在你的腰间，眼角带着晶莹泪花，迷离而动情地低喘：“要是你早生十年……我早就把你拐去民政局了啊……”
data.location: lived-in cozy bachelor apartment living room with empty beer cans on table
data.action: pinned on living room sofa with sweatshirt pulled down, flushed with beer, wrapping long legs around partner waist, whispering tearfully “if only you were born ten years earlier...”
data.lighting: dim ambient corner lamp illuminating flushed skin and disheveled black hair
data.mood: mature woman heartbreak transformed into passionate surrender, heated adult intimacy
data.promptProse: Pinned on apartment sofa with an off-shoulder sweatshirt, slightly drunk Shizuka wraps legs around partner waist with flushed cheeks and tearful passionate eyes.
data.animaCaption: Shizuka Hiratsuka flushed on apartment sofa in passionate embrace.
